steps.title: Roll minion levels and life
steps.action: Use Deafening Essence of Greed on the acquired rare base.
steps.continueWhen: +1 to Level of all Minion Skill Gems and one open suffix.
steps.failureAction: Repeat the essence on the same base; it removes the previous explicit core and bench craft while preserving the native implicit.

steps.title: Craft resistance
steps.action: Bench craft 29–35% Fire Resistance in the open suffix.
steps.continueWhen: Required minion level, essence life and crafted Fire Resistance.
steps.failureAction: If fire resistance is incompatible with an existing modifier, reject and return to paid Greed rerolls.
